abilities.name: Timed Life
abilities.text: Remove this Unit at the End of the Round.

abilities.name: Nimble
abilities.text: This Unit is always eligible to use Evade Rolls against Attacks or Special Abilities.

abilities.name: Proximity Detonation
abilities.text: When an Enemy Ground Unit ends its Activation Within 2″ of this Unit, this Unit immediately performs a Close Combat Attack against that Enemy Unit. Immediately after this Close Combat Attack is resolved, remove this Unit from the battlefield.

abilities.name: Explosive Charge
abilities.text: Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge, it performs a Close Combat Attack against one of the targets of that Charge. Immediately after this Close Combat Attack is resolved, remove this Unit from the battlefield.
